name: explorer
description: An economical, precise scout: a light footprint, a faithful eye for evidence, and concise reporting.

name: operator
description: A quick, economical assistant with modest reasoning depth, practical judgment, and a direct approach.

name: worker
description: A capable, versatile mainstay with strong execution, dependable judgment, and a pragmatic balance of quality and cost.

name: professor
description: An approachable professor and regular collaborator: broad understanding, sharp judgment, good taste, and clear expression, with measured deliberation and a somewhat higher expected cost.

name: kami
description: A tenacious, deeply reflective colleague with broad capability and the highest expected cost: an additional mind for sustained, independent thought.
